modulos.description: One per module of the CURRENT module_map, in map order.

dependeDe.description: The current module_map's `dependsOn`: what this module CONSUMES.

expoe.description: What it exposes. `null` = the Architect declared no contract for this module (different from exposing nothing).

assinatura.example: placePiece(board: Board, piece: Piece, pos: Pos): Board

descricao.example: Returns a new board; never mutates the one passed in.

contratosForaDoMapa.description: Contracts of modules the current module_map no longer has — said, never attached to a module that does not exist.

403.description: Service token missing or different from the shared one.
